name: The Jester
bio: The class clown who grew up kind. Quick with the joke that lets a stuck moment breathe, and happy to be laughed at so nobody else has to risk it.
sceneStory: Head thrown back mid-laugh, a harlequin lifts off the floor of a deep, dark canyon, carried upward by nothing at all. They tumble head-over-heels into a field of stars, laughter streaming behind them like the tail of a comet.
